IsAllowed.rationale: OTHER CHARACTERS -- the one waiver category the shared contract names outright. The whole event is 'take a card reward from ANOTHER character's colour': its option list is built by walking CardPoolColorOrder (Necrobinder, Ironclad, Regent, Silent, Defect) and keeping the pools that are not the player's own (ColorfulPhilosophers.cs:18-25, 39-45). In an Ironclad-only sim that set is empty by construction, so the gate is not merely unsatisfiable today -- it is unsatisfiable for as long as the sim's scope holds. This is NOT the 'no ported content triggers it' shape rule 1 calls a dormant gap.
